# Aussie Surveillance

> Aussie Surveillance designs, supplies and installs CCTV, alarm, access control, video management and cloud security systems for homes and businesses. Based in Echuca, Victoria, servicing customers across Australia.

30 years of security industry experience. 100% Australian owned. ASIAL member.

## Company
- [About](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/about.html): Company background and experience.
- [Contact](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/contact.html): Phone, email and enquiry details. Call 1300 899 708.

## Products & Services
- [Products & Services overview](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/products.html): Full range of CCTV, alarm, access control, video management and cloud security offerings.
- [Hikvision CCTV](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-hikvision-cctv.html): Hikvision CCTV camera and NVR kits.
- [Dahua CCTV](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-dahua-cctv.html): Dahua CCTV camera and NVR kits.
- [Ajax Alarm and CCTV](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-ajax-alarm-cctv.html): Ajax wireless alarm and CCTV with app control.
- [Bosch Solution 6000](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-bosch-solution-6000.html): Bosch alarm system for larger homes and businesses.
- [Bosch Solution 3000](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-bosch-solution-3000.html): Bosch alarm system for smaller properties.
- [Ness D8 & D16](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-ness-d8-d16.html): Ness alarm panels.
- [Tecom Alarm and Access Control](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-tecom-access-control.html): Access control and alarm systems.
- [DW Spectrum VMS](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-dw-spectrum-vms.html): Video management software.
- [Nx Witness VMS](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-nx-witness-vms.html): Video management system for commercial camera networks.
- [Cloud Security Services](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-cloud-security-services.html): Cloud-connected remote monitoring.
- [Redundancy Systems](https://aussiesurveillance.com.au/product-redundancy-systems.html): Redundant storage and infrastructure for security systems.
